mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.tenant_id, p.title, p.type, p.status, p.description, p.linked_kb_id, p.metadata, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, COALESCE(c.chapter_count, 0) AS chapter_count, COALESCE(d.script_draft_count, 0) AS script_draft_count FROM story_project p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS chapter_count FROM story_chapter GROUP BY project_id ) c ON c.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS script_draft_count FROM story_script_draft GROUP BY project_id ) d ON d.project_id = p.id WHERE p.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_project (tenant_id, title, type, status, description, linked_kb_id, metadata, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{title}, #{type}, #{status}, #{description}, #{linkedKbId}, #{metadata}::jsonb, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE story_project SET title = #{title}, type = #{type}, status = #{status}, description = #{description}, linked_kb_id = #{linkedKbId}, metadata = #{metadata}::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
